description: The INITIALIZE THEN REPLACING connective - a 2002 introduction. Folded from the inline InitializeBinder gate (Exec Step E).
citation: ISO §2023:14.9.20.2 (the THEN connective is 2002+; REPLACING itself is COBOL-85)
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. RWITRP.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 A PIC X(3) VALUE "ABC".
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    INITIALIZE A THEN REPLACING ALPHANUMERIC DATA BY "Z".
    STOP RUN.
